newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber rise limit on firmer cash, report.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber rise limit on firmer cash, report.

text.p: CME January and March lumber futures shot up their $10 limit as carryover demand from Friday's limit gains triggered buy-stop orders.
Traders also cited firmer cash market ideas and a bullish construction report.
After their bull runs, January was at $402.20 and March at $388.70 per tbf.
Traders pointed to expectations that cash markets would firm in the wake of U.S. Thanksgiving.
U.S. Commerce Department said total October construction spending was up 1.8 percent, the largest increase for any month since last March. Economists had predicted a 1.0 percent decrease.
The futures market also looks technically firm after the sharp turnaround posted last week, traders added.
